subject: Read-ahead capacity request / authorization for Solaris Labs (late-stage)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Read-ahead capacity request / Solaris Labs (DL-2029-0453)

Hi team,

Solaris Labs is at an internally committed pilot sign-off stage and asking for a firm runway for the first 90 days post-launch. Deal team (Ben) and I reviewed forecasts — attached is the customer projection and the minimal perf targets. High level ask: can Ops provision a read-ahead authorization (not a formal reserved contract) to hold ~4 x A100-equivalent slots (or 8 x T4-equivalent burst capacity) for a 3 month window starting 2029-12-15, with the option to convert to a committed Dedicated pool if they convert to annual terms?

What I need from Ops:
- Quick confirmation of free capacity across regions (us-west1/us-east1) for the requested window
- What a "read-ahead lock" would look like operationally (soft hold, tagging, priority routing) and any ticket/commitment required
- Cost-of-goods delta (est. $/token per config or pool) and whether this impacts other late-stage deals in the same timeframe

Ben: I will introduce you to the procurement contact after we confirm internal feasibility.

Timeline: I need a readiness answer by EOD 2029-11-16 to keep the runway for their procurement cadence.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Enterprise Deals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: solaris_final_pricing_v3.pdf, readahead_capacity_template.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-11-15T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Read-ahead capacity request / Solaris Labs (DL-2029-0453)

Irene / Ben —

Thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. Quick ops assessment below after an initial inventory sweep:

1) Availability (2029-12-15 -> 2030-03-15)
   - us-west1: 6 x A100-equivalent slots open across dedicated and preemptible pools (can carve 4 for read-ahead without impacting active commits)
   - us-east1: 3 x A100-equivalent slots open (we can provide burst via spot capacity but not guaranteed)

2) What a read-ahead looks like
   - Recommended: Create a soft "readahead lock" ticket that tags 4 A100-equivalent nodes with a 90-day TTL and a concurrency priority flag. This will not adjust customer billing until conversion to a reserved contract.
   - Operational steps: reserve node tags -> update routing policy to prefer tagged nodes for Solaris traffic -> set automated fallback rules to downgrade to compatible smaller model quantizations if capacity dips below threshold.

3) Cost delta / impact
   - Holding cost: estimated $12k/month in opportunity-weighted capacity cost for 4 A100 slots (reflects lost spot revenue).
   - This is non-billable to customer while in read-ahead unless legal signs a short-term standby fee; recommend we absorb for 1 month, then discuss a nominal standby fee ($3k/mo) if they need the full 90 days.
   - Impact: two other late-stage deals (AuroraCode, Triton POC) have softer runway in the same window; carving these 4 will reduce our burst margin but is manageable.

If you want us to proceed with creating the readahead lock ticket, we need a written internal approval (ops -> steward) and an expected conversion trigger date (e.g., LOI signed by 2029-12-01) so we can prioritize.

I'll prepare the ticket template and TTL automation once you confirm.

- Aditya
Senior Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: readahead_capacity_template.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@solarislabs.ai>, procurement@solarislabs.ai
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-11-16T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Solaris read-ahead / proposed runway (DL-2029-0453)

Maya — thanks again for the productive session yesterday. Quick note to align expectations from our side:

- Redwood can hold a short-term read-ahead runway in advance of contract signature. We are assessing operational feasibility internally now and will confirm capacity and any nominal standby costs by EOD tomorrow.
- To help Ops, could you confirm your expected conversion trigger? Helpful examples: signed LOI, initial PO, or a firm procurement milestone.

Next steps for Solaris:
1) Please indicate which trigger you expect (LOI / PO / other) and your target date.
2) If legal/procurement prefers a short-term standby fee rather than Redwood absorbing cost, let us know a standby budget range (we recommend $0 - $5k/month for a 4-node window).

Will loop back once Ops confirms.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@solarislabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@solarislabs.ai, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-11-16T11:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Solaris read-ahead / proposed runway (DL-2029-0453)

Ben / Irene —

Thanks — Solaris is aiming to have an LOI signed with our board by 2029-11-28. The procurement team will start an expedited review once the LOI is in place. We prefer a nominal standby fee to make the hold contractual; $3k/mo for the requested window is within our expected budget.

We can execute a short one-page hold agreement if that speeds things up. Please send a draft and the ops readout so we can align procurement.

Maya
Head of Platform, Solaris Labs
maya.patel@solarislabs.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-11-17T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Read-ahead capacity request / authorization for Solaris Labs (DL-2029-0453)

Aditya / Irene —

Thanks for the assessment and Ben / Maya for the alignment. Approving the creation of a 90-day read-ahead lock for Solaris Labs with the following constraints:

- Hold: 4 x A100-equivalent nodes in us-west1 (primary), optional burst in us-east1 as available
- TTL: 90 days starting 2029-12-15; ops to create a ticket with automatic TTL expiry and a 7-day pre-expiry notice to sales + account exec
- Standby fee: $3k/month (to be invoiced if Solaris signs the one-page hold agreement); if they decline, Redwood will absorb the first 30 days and reassess
- Escalation: If cluster utilization across us-west1 dips below 10% free margin for more than 24 hours during the hold, trigger capacity re-evaluation and notify Irene and Stephanie immediately

Aditya: please generate the readahead ticket, tag nodes, and post the runbook link in the ticket. Ben/Irene: prepare the one-page hold agreement and send to Maya so they can sign before 2029-11-20 if possible.

Approved —
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Capacity & Operations
Redwood Inference
